observed_source_path.finding: Production owner lease and controller award callback call LumoAppState.recordMemoryResult.
Completed round awards the real wallet before saving statistics and the rewarded receipt; the same owner+round result ID must remain retryable.
Validates current profile and Memory amounts, queues the wallet call, removes the pending entry only on normal completion, preserves it and exposes an error on failure.

Original instance does not advance its wallet after false/exception. A new repository can load an optimistic preferences value, then previously returned an already-present result ID without another positive platform acknowledgement.

api_limits: Positive duplicate acknowledgement is the existing platform setString Boolean contract; not an independent disk reread or power-loss/fsync guarantee.

Existing legacy load fallback, amounts, daily streaks, Cards streak, result-ID JSON and profile APIs remain byte-identical.
No local Dart/Flutter invocation, dependency download, product-device test or Git Tree/Commit/Ref/PR mutation was performed.
